title: Wellington, St Patrick's Roman Catholic Church - WW1 and 2
memorial_details:
description: OF YOUR CHARITY PRAY FOR THE SOULS OF THE FOLLOWING MEN FROM THIS PARISH:/ (Names)/ AND ALL THE MEN FROM WELLINGTON WHO FELL IN THE GREAT WAR 1914-1918. ETERNAL REST GIVE UNTO THEM, O LORD, AND LET PERPETUAL LIGHT SHINE UPON THEM. IN MEMORY OF THE ABOVE THIS CRUCIFIX WAS ERECTED BY THE CATHOLICS OF WELLINGTON, AUGUST 1920.

Additional plaque: FLIGHT LIEUTENANT C P WOOD DFC KILLED IN ACTION IN THE SECOND WORLD WAR
